description: Erection of two storey roof extension alongside associated external alterations and partial demolition of existing building to create a private garden.
decision_conditions:
<p>The noise level from all plant and machinery included in the approved development shall at all times remain 5dB(A) below background levels when measured at any nearby residential window or other sensitive receptor.&nbsp;</p><p>
REASON: To ensure that occupiers of neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance.&nbsp;</p>

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>No development shall commence until full details and samples of all new external facing and roofing materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The details must include the type, size, colour, profile, texture, and bonding/pointing method of the materials.</p><p>The development shall only be carried out using the approved materials and shall be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p>

REASON: In the interest of the visual amenities of the surrounding area.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of development, a detailed scheme for privacy screening shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The details must include the screening's height, location, materials, design (such as louvre spacing or solid panels), and any associated planting.</p><p>The privacy screening shall be fully installed in accordance with the approved details prior to the first use of the roof terrace and shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the residential amenities and privacy of the occupants of the neighbouring dwelling at Prospect Row.</p>
